summary: All 7 phases complete and verified. Gating suite (oracle/run-oracle-suite.sh) now deselects slow on both passes, streams progress via a shared-core instrumentation contract (JSONL/heartbeat/report.json/SCAN_COMPLETE marker), asserts soundness over a persisted known-conclusive baseline (103/274, 0 disagreements), and runs green in ~16.1min on an idle machine (~4.76x speedup vs ~76.7min). Exhaustive path (run-oracle-exhaustive-scan.sh) is a separate, explicitly-invoked entry point. Documented in TESTING_GUIDE.md 8.8 and oracle README. Hard constraint held throughout: _assert_scan_report, SELF_SCAN_SOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS, MIN_CONCLUSIVE_SCAN_FORMULAS unmodified in the full cumulative diff.

blockers.description: Non-blocking, informational: this dev machine is shared with other concurrent sessions running heavy Lean proof searches (observed 300-1200% CPU from a single lean --worker process). During Phase 6, that external contention intermittently pushed oracle/'s tight-budget xdist_serial Z3 solves over SELF_SCAN_SOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS (98-99/103 vs 103/103 clean on MIN_CONCLUSIVE_GATING_FORMULAS=100), and two pre-existing untouched xdist_serial tests failed the same way in the same runs -- confirming this is the pre-existing 'tight solve-budget headroom' sensitivity already documented in oracle/conftest.py and TESTING_GUIDE.md 8.6, not a regression from this task. disagreements stayed 0 throughout. No threshold was changed. Task considered complete; this is recorded for awareness, not as unfinished work.

decisions_made: D1/D2/D3 as planned. ORACLE_SCAN_OUT_DIR env var wires test_complexity_5_scan_self_consistent's artifact_dir so the exhaustive script drives pytest directly per D2, without changing default (unset) behaviour.
test_report_writes_to_file relocated to new TestComplexity3ScanReportWriting (gating pass), within Phase 3's declared TestFullScanReport-class-body territory.
Manifest index is 0-based (direct Python list indexing), converted from progress.jsonl's 1-based idx.
MIN_CONCLUSIVE_GATING_FORMULAS=100 (separate constant), derived from manifest conclusive_count=103 minus slack for the 8.646s slowest observed conclusive solve against the 10000ms budget.
ORACLE_PASS1_TIMEOUT/ORACLE_PASS2_TIMEOUT calibrated to 1300s/900s (~2x measured idle-machine wall clock).
dead_ends: Manually overriding -m via run-oracle-suite.sh's trailing "$@" (e.g. -m "not slow") collapses with the script's own -m flag (last wins), corrupting the xdist_serial partition and causing contention-induced OracleTimeoutError test failures unrelated to real regressions -- do not use this as a verification method once Phase 3's fixed -m expressions are in place.
